rule: Do not derive free_driver from career_start/career_end alone.
database_action: Use active intervals + visibility + F1 eligibility + availability status.

rule: Do not use later F1 debut to prove 1980 F1 eligibility.
database_action: Future debut is hidden/reference after career start.

rule: Temporary retirement/hiatus prevents ordinary free-driver classification.
database_action: Use returnable_retired_inactive_not_seeking unless reliable 1980 seeking evidence exists.

rule: External ratings are derived calibration, not source-locked facts.
database_action: Store uncertainty, source evidence and derived_gameplay_baseline status.

rule: Junior/feeder milestones support visibility/readiness only when before career start.
After career start, driver availability becomes Save World state.
